posts.zh:
dsh-plugin-kit#search 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH Web GUI 的全局搜索插件：侧边栏全局搜索框全文搜索历史会话（走 sessionQuery 全文索引，未启用时降级为逐会话扫描）与设置面板，关键词高亮，点击直达会话或对应设置卡片。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-5f0609d28c74083912f0.html
posts.en:
dsh-plugin-kit#search is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Full-text global search for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar search box that searches history sessions (via the sessionQuery index, with a per-session scan fallback) and settings panels, highlights matches, and jumps to the matching session or settings card.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-5f0609d28c74083912f0.html
